title: Local quantum Cuntz--Krieger algebras of dephasing quantum graphs
summary: We establish a general structure theorem for local quantum Cuntz--Krieger families associated to finite quantum graphs whose relations are analogous to those of the partial isometries generating an ordinary graph $C^*$-algebra, with the quantum edge correspondence governing composition. We apply this structure theorem to the quantum dephasing graph on $M_n$ to obtain an explicit isomorphism between $O_n$ and the local quantum Cuntz--Krieger algebra.
